Key Responsibilities
•	Follow the guidance and instructions of the Executive Chef and Head Chef, contributing to a collaborative and efficient kitchen environment.
•	Prepare and cook a wide range of dishes in large quantities for daily service and special events, ensuring consistent quality and adherence to recipes.
•	Strictly adhere to the Food Safety Plan and Australian Food Safety Regulations, maintaining a high standard of hygiene and food safety practices.

•	Monitor the quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation, ensuring consistent adherence to Hotel Newman's high standards.
•	Inspect kitchen equipment and work areas to ensure they are sanitary and ready for operation, maintaining a clean and safe working environment.
•	Introduce new culinary skills and techniques to the team, contributing to ongoing learning and development within the kitchen.

Skills and Experience
•	Formal culinary qualifications or equivalent experience.
•	Proven experience in a similar role within a high-volume, quality-focused kitchen.
•	Excellent culinary skills and a passion for creating delicious food.
•	Strong understanding of food safety and hygiene practices.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
•	Ability to work under pressure and maintain a positive attitude.   

Benefits
•	Competitive salary in line with the Hospitality Award ($79,423 per annum).
•	Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team in a renowned establishment.
•	Contribute to delivering exceptional dining experiences for our guests.

To Apply
Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and skills to hr@acuream.com.au

We offer on-site accommodation and meals to our staff. This is not a FIFO position.
